content.text:
Both tests pass. 

The bug was in `is_expired` (repo/cache.py): it used strict `age > ttl`, so an entry at exactly the TTL (`age == ttl`) counted as still fresh, one tick later than the documented contract ("age == ttl is expired"). Changed it to `age >= ttl`.

This also fixes the two consumers that route through the same helper: `old_ttl_check` in cache.py and the `expired_count` tally in `repo/rows.py`, both of which were undercounting boundary entries. I removed the now-resolved BUG comment; the `old_ttl_check` TODO is a separate migration note I left alone.
